applicabilityBasis.summary: Maple identifies syrupUSDG as a proportional share of a dynamic loan and strategy portfolio, expressly states that it is not a stablecoin and disclaims one-to-one USDG backing or guaranteed return of principal. Its variable NAV and USDG-denominated exit do not establish the fixed monetary-value redemption obligation required by GENIUS Act section 2(22). This is a scope finding about Maple's token, not a finding about Paxos USDG.

genius.notes: Maple's exact-product disclosure identifies Maple International Operations SPC acting on behalf of and for the account of Maple USDG Segregated Portfolio 1 as the issuer and manager. This informational payment-stablecoin scope finding is not a securities-law opinion or an authorization claim. No parent issuer licence, GENIUS approval or MiCA finding is inherited.
